name: Tomás Herrera
headline: Product Manager at Greenway Bikes
about: I turn messy user research into clear product decisions. I started as a journalist, so I still believe the best questions are short ones. Right now I work on apps that help people commute by bike.

experience.title: Product Manager
experience.description: Owns the bike-sharing app with 120,000 monthly riders. Launched a route planner that avoids steep hills, which raised weekly rides by 18 percent.

experience.title: UX Researcher
experience.description: Ran more than 200 user interviews for a patient appointment app. Built the research library that the whole design team used.

experience.title: Technology Reporter
experience.description: Wrote about local start-ups and digital services for a regional newspaper.

education.details: Thesis on how older adults learn new mobile apps.

projects.name: Small Screens podcast
projects.description: A monthly podcast about mobile design, with 45 episodes so far.

projects.name: Plain-language checklist
projects.description: A free checklist for writing app texts that everyone can understand, used by several local agencies.

volunteering: Guides weekend tours at a city science museum.
